blocks.x: FNOL-to-settlement on governed agents — cycle time down 58% and claims leakage down 12% at unchanged adjuster headcount
Identity withheld — a motor insurer whose claims promise was measured in weeks while its competitors' was measured in hours. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline fortnight traced the promise gap: first-notification-of-loss data arrived complete for 58% of claims, and the other 42% crawled while adjusters chased photos, police references and repair quotes.
Triage ran on claim amount alone, so the expensive small claims — injury, liability dispute, fraud indicators — waited behind straightforward glass damage that had been auto-priority by amount.

We rebuilt the claim journey on governed agents: intake completes itself against connected sources where consent allows, severity triage reads injury-liability-fraud signals instead of amounts, and every settlement recommendation carries its evidence file — photos, estimates, policy terms — with the adjuster's decision recorded. Leakage analytics ran continuously against closed files, not annually.
